404.title: Page Not Found
404.message: We couldn't find the page you're looking for. The address may be incorrect, outdated, or the page may have been moved. Check the URL you entered or go back home.

423.title: Locked
423.message: This resource is currently locked and cannot be processed.

429.title: Too Many Requests
429.message: We received too many requests in a short period of time. Wait a moment before trying again so the system can safely handle your request.

500.title: Internal Server Error
500.message: A server-side problem occurred and the request could not be processed correctly. If this error keeps happening, please contact us and describe what you were trying to do.

503.title: Service Unavailable
503.message: The service is temporarily unavailable because the server is overloaded or maintenance is in progress. This is usually short-lived, so please try again in a few minutes. If the problem persists, please contact us.
